headline: LunR Reports Q2 2026 Results Including Inaugural Cash Flow
summary: LunR Royalties Corp. ("LunR", or the "Company") (TSX: LUNR) is pleased to announce its operating and financial results for the three months ended June 30, 2026. During the quarter, LunR began receiving silver deliveries under its life-of-mine silver stream on the Fruta del Norte mine (the "FDN Stream"), which resulted in the Company recording its first quarterly revenue and positive cash flow generation.
